_doc: Split screen and the two-player games in the client (src/client/split.ts, src/client/twoplayer.ts; the games themselves are the sim's: docs/mechanics/modes.md). wideAspect: side by side when the screen is at least this wide (width / height), else top and bottom. renderScale: the render scale (of the screen's) while split, since two views cost more than one (Quality: auto still moves it). ao: ambient occlusion while split (real look). ?split=npc (and skate clip --split npc) puts a park NPC in as player 2, a dev stand-in. twoPlayer: each player's colour (split tags, Graffiti tags in the world, results), the games on the 2 Players menu (id: the sim's run, or free), the join line, the results card's words ({n}: the player), and Graffiti's tint: how high it sits over a grind line, its core's and halo's radius (m), and how opaque a tagged gap's areas are.

modes.name: Trick Attack
modes.line: Two minutes, both skating. The higher score wins.

modes.name: HORSE
modes.line: At the S.K.A.T.E. spot: set a trick, the other matches it or takes a letter. Spell HORSE and you lose.

modes.name: Graffiti
modes.line: Trick a ledge, a rail or a gap to tag it in your colour. A bigger combo steals it. Most tags wins.

modes.name: Free Skate
modes.line: No clock, no rules. Just the two of you.

twoPlayer.join: Player 2: press {ollie}, or ✕ on the second pad

lines.graffiti2p: Most obstacles tagged when the clock ran out.
